cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says control of state data is a stated goal or a rule in force; the domestic hosting of identity data (TGO-001) does not answer that.
cells.note: A Togolese delegation said in October 2025 that all identity data is hosted in national infrastructure (TGO-001), but no source in the window states a goal or a rule on state data. Under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 hosting alone places nothing, so the cell is unplaced.
